questions.question_text: Walk me through your career so far and what led you to apply for this role at Nestle as a Data Engineer.
What best practices do you follow to ensure your ETL pipelines are reliable and maintainable over time?
Can you explain how you have used Airflow in your previous work and how it can benefit a data engineering team?
Imagine you notice a significant drop in performance in one of the ETL pipelines you designed. How would you approach diagnosing and resolving the issue?
Describe a time when you used SQL to solve a complex data problem. What was the problem and how did SQL help you address it?
How would you design an ETL process for a company that needs to integrate data from multiple sources with varying data formats and update frequencies?
